s1.text: Prototype controls (dashed strip under the header) are not part of the product: cycle the four scenarios, simulate a merge, flip the theme and reduced motion. Click a CI run to drill into jobs and steps. Click Sync or Sync all to walk the preview, confirm, streamed run.

s2.text: One status language for every section: shape plus label plus color. Idle, Running, Clear, Speed bump, Boulder, Done. Meters carry their denominator; the fill stripes at 70% and caps with the boulder glyph at 100%.
